pages.title: The Last Crossing
paragraphs: After a full day beneath the enchanted forest's canopy, the party reaches open fields in the orange light of sunset. Beyond the fenced village, a vast stone bridge carries the road toward Aldermere. Its far bank is lost in the distance. Knights have sealed the near entrance.
"The last company we admitted could still speak," the captain calls. "By morning they could not. No one crosses."

Three villagers shelter in cottages around the village square and orchard. Linus holds the orchard wall with his lance while Leon, a hired sword, guards the path back to the houses. Both turn toward Maria's party as the beasts close in. The knights at the bridge still face the refugees.

pages.title: Defend the Villagers
paragraphs: Visit each of the three houses from its door or an adjacent tile to begin an escort. Villagers are vulnerable even before you reach them. Each has 26 HP and cannot fight.

Escorted villagers move up to three tiles toward the green refuge at the end of each player phase, before the beasts act. Keep their routes clear and protect them until they reach it. Healing staves can heal them.

Resolve all three rescues, defeat the captain, clear the forest beasts and their finite waves, then bring Maria to the marked bridge entrance. Maria must survive. A villager's death reduces your reward but does not end the chapter.

pages.title: Linus and Leon
paragraphs: Linus and Leon are controllable allies from the start; no Talk action is needed. Linus is a level-14 Cavalier with a Steel Lance, a Potion and seven movement. Leon is a level-9 Mercenary carrying a Steel Sword, Beast Killer and a Potion, with strong Strength, Dexterity and Speed growths. Equip Beast Killer against wolves and wolfmen: its might is tripled against beasts, helping him hold the orchard and earn catch-up EXP from finishing blows. His Orders Emblem promotion at level 20 makes him a Hero, retaining Swords and gaining Axes.

A western hunting pack and a wolfman are already closing on the village. Split your defenders between the evacuation lane and orchard. Finite waves alternate between the western forest entrance on turns 2 and 6 and the eastern entrance on turns 4 and 8: three, three, four and four beasts. Later packs contain more wolfmen. Red markers show their entrances; warnings appear one turn ahead, even with tutorials disabled. Blocked entrances queue arrivals rather than moving them behind your defenders. Brush grants cover but slows movement.

On turn 5, the two flank knights leave the bridge and advance into the square. A warning on turn 4 gives you time to cover the escorts. The Order targets your fighters, not civilians. Varric and the center knight hold the bridge. His Javelin can strike and counter at range 1-2, and is yours if you defeat him.

pages.title: Every Life Matters
paragraphs: One rescued villager grants two Potions. Two also grant Wind, a light, accurate tome effective against flying foes, and a battered Orders Emblem for promoting a level 20 ally. All three also entrust you with a Crossing Keepsake worth 10 Insight.
Rewards are cumulative and go to Maria, or the convoy if her inventory is full. The captain's Javelin is a separate drop.

pages.title: Linus Joins
paragraphs: "They told us to hold the crossing. Not to leave these people to die." Linus steadies his horse as Maria reaches him. "If you mean to get them out, my lance is yours."
Linus is a Cavalier with balanced stats, strong Defense and Strength, and seven movement. His wounds remain when he joins: use his Potion or a healer to get him back on his feet.
He can wield spears and swords, and promotes to Paladin at level 20 with an Orders Emblem.
